caption: The drawing depicts a single, metal coffee pot with a tall, conical body, a long curved spout on the left side, and a prominent handle on the right. The coffee pot has a fitted, domed lid with a small round knob at its top center. The body and lid of the coffee pot are decorated with a floral motif featuring red and pink flowers, green leaves, and some red and purple circular shapes that may suggest fruit; the decoration is mainly concentrated on the front surface of the pot. There is a border of alternating green-colored shapes circling the bottom edge and the base of the lid. The background is plain and beige, providing clear contrast for the dark, oxidized blue-gray and slightly textured appearance of the coffee pot. The artist's signature appears in red in the lower right portion of the image.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
